subject: af-td
title: AF.TD.------AFI(1)
description: Chart on book p. 93 ((AF)D-21). AF-TD (affinity tendencies) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". The title names AFI(1); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: SF-RZ (self-realization) and AFI1 (affinity insight—first degree). From SF-RZ: TM (terminology—or terms of a definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and SOC-RT-P (social reality particular). From SOC-RT-P: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics), PER-TRS (perceived transition) and AFL (affinity alignment). From AFL: ACT-T (actual terms) and IST-F (isolated focus). ALT-F (alternative functionalism) is on a dotted line from ACT-T.
